report_metadata.title: Croatian Court Evidence Exclusion Analysis Report - EXPANDED
report_metadata.analysis_method: Parallel subagent dispatch + direct WebFetch analysis
report_metadata.batch: Original 557 + New URLs 1-400 from expanded 726-URL dataset

key_findings.overall_trend: Croatian courts strongly favor evidence retention over exclusion. Of 536 analyzed decisions, 107 (20.0%) resulted in successful full or partial exclusion - 44 full exclusions and 63 partial exclusions.
top_exclusion_grounds_by_frequency: Witness violations (42 cases) - Not simultaneously present, only 1 witness, witness left during search
Warrantless searches (28 cases) - No judicial authorization when required
Inspection vs search exceeded (19 cases) - Inspection actions transformed into unlawful searches
Fruit of poisoned tree (12 cases) - Derivatives of unlawfully obtained evidence
Police informal statements (9 cases) - Službene bilješke, informal conversations
Coercion/procedural violence (4 cases) - Physical force, threats, visible injuries
common_rejection_grounds: Procedural compliance with ZKP requirements was established
Defendant voluntarily waived rights (e.g., counsel presence)
Formal defects deemed insufficient to invalidate evidence
Voluntary surrender/consent negated search illegality claims
Valid court orders covered challenged procedures
Inspection vs search - items in plain view/visible spaces
Foreign witness citizenship irrelevant to witness qualification
successful_exclusion_patterns: Fruit of the poisonous tree doctrine (čl. 10. st. 2. toč. 4. ZKP)
Witness presence violations (čl. 214, 217 ZKP) - most common ground
Warrantless home searches without proper exceptions
Warrant timing violations - warrant issued after search commenced
Urgency evaporated upon detention - must obtain warrant
Witness participation vs signature - mere signing insufficient
Coercion physical evidence - visible injuries indicate unlawful methods
new_grounds_discovered_batches_5_6: Warrant faxed AFTER search already started (I Kž-281/2008-3)
Financial police authority limits - cannot open locked furniture (Kzz-10/2003-2)
Witness participation vs signing - second witness only signed after (I Kž-459/2006-3)
Coercion physical evidence - defendant had broken teeth (I Kž-305/2003-3)
Outdated statutory forms invalidate search (I Kž-499/2003-3)
Witness left to make phone call (I Kž-478/2007-5)
new_grounds_discovered_expanded_batches_: Simultaneous witness-defendant role - Cannot be both searched person and witness (Kž-628/2024-4)
Attorney qualification 10-year rule - Counsel must have 10+ years practice (I Kž-Us-61/2012-4)
Temporary guest distinction - Guest stays don't receive full home protections (I Kž-557/1998-5)
Vehicle vs premises distinction - Art. 214 witness rules apply only to premises (Kž-631/2008-4)
ECHR retroactive exclusion - ECtHR rulings can trigger domestic exclusion (I Kž-71/2011-6)
Foreign evidence verification - Evidence from abroad must meet Croatian standards (I Kž-Us 7/2014-9)
Expert search without authorization - Expert cannot independently search devices (I Kž-668/2019-4)
Police inspection vs search distinction - Art. 75 ZPPO inspection lawful vs Art. 246 search (Kž-884/2021-3)

legal_framework.primary_statute: Zakon o kaznenom postupku (ZKP) - Criminal Procedure Act
key_provisions: Članak 10 ZKP - Prohibition on use of unlawfully obtained evidence
Članak 9 ZKP/97 - Prior definition of unlawful evidence
Članak 217 ZKP - Witness requirements for searches
Članak 250 ZKP - Exhaustive grounds for search evidence exclusion
Članak 34 Ustav RH - Constitutional right to home inviolability
notable_doctrines: Fruit of the poisonous tree (plodovi otrovne voćke)

for_defense_attorneys: Focus on constitutional violations (čl. 34 Ustav) for strongest exclusion arguments
Document all procedural irregularities at time of search/seizure
Challenge witness qualifications (age, relationship to parties)
Invoke fruit of poisonous tree doctrine for derivative evidence
Challenge search authorization deficiencies under čl. 242, 250 ZKP
Monitor consent validity - was it truly voluntary?
Challenge hearsay evidence under čl. 344(4) and 86 ZKP
for_prosecutors: Ensure proper documentation of consent and rights waivers
Maintain clear chain of custody with timestamps
Use properly qualified witnesses for all searches (verify age requirements)
Obtain judicial authorization even when arguably not required
Document defendant requests for nighttime searches
Record audio/video of critical procedures when possible
